checklist.evidence: Hand simulation. Deps are [], so a re-render never runs cleanup. A key change (scope :79 includes token, product JSON and commerceEnabled) or an unmount deletes the fiber. The mechanism is confirmed. The layout effect at :109 is the only liveness signal. Under React 19, a Suspense re-suspend or Activity hide disconnects layout effects but keeps state. A continuation that lands while hidden returns at :131 or :136, so on reveal the outcome stays {phase:'busy'}. That means 'Submitting request...' shows (:184) with no :190 alert and no :196 link. The lock holds, so there is no duplicate. It is latent: no lazy(), use(), Activity or transition exists under ProductPage or products-diagnostics, and the only lazy is ProductPage itself (section.tsx:167), which resolves before the form exists. The proposed fix ('the adapter could opt into a known-denial list') would therefore NOT work for 503. The fix must be at the route (400/403 for commerce_disabled) or a coded-503 branch in api.ts.
